bagPolicy.summary: At Purdue athletics events, one clear bag up to 12" x 6" x 12", one one-gallon clear bag and one clutch up to 4.5" x 6.5" are allowed.
allowed: One clear plastic, vinyl or PVC bag up to 12" x 6" x 12"
One small clutch up to 4.5" x 6.5"
Medical and diaper bags after inspection
bagPolicy.note: Medical and diaper bags are accepted at all Mackey Arena entrances after inspection. Items cannot be left at the gates and must go back to your vehicle. This is the Purdue Athletics policy.

parking.summary: Men’s basketball single-game parking is sold in Northwestern Garage or Upper H Lot, with an ADA placard required for Upper H. Free shuttles from R and H lots start two hours before tipoff and run until about one hour after the game.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Mackey Arena. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: Boilermaker Hospitality operates concession stands offering food and drinks.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: On game day, ticket holders may request an exchange to accessible seating beginning at 9 a.m., subject to availability.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Guests who exit Mackey Arena are not allowed to re-enter.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Game-day ticket sales and will-call pickup are at the Athletics Ticket Office in Mackey Arena.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: General fan entrances open 90 minutes before tipoff; the student Paint Crew entrance opens 105 minutes before tipoff, and premium club access begins two hours before tipoff.
